Aspinall arrives in Dortmund as the number six seed after fifteen European Tour events, while Cristo Reyes scraped into the 32-man field as seed 27, the widest seeding gap of Friday's evening session bar one. Over a race to six legs the favourite still has to produce, but Aspinall's year-long consistency on this exact circuit is what the seeding measures. Back Aspinall to win the match.
